files.role: FastAPI application entry point. Configures CORS, installs platform error handlers and request timing, mounts calendar router, initialises DB pool and schema on startup.
Postgres connection pool management and schema initialisation. Reads DB connection string from environment. Runs migrations/001_init.sql on startup via init_schema().

methods.name: init_pool
methods.purpose: Initialise the module-level psycopg2 connection pool from environment variables.

methods.name: get_db
methods.purpose: Yield a database connection from the pool; return it on exit.

methods.name: init_schema
methods.purpose: Execute migrations/001_init.sql to ensure all tables exist (idempotent).

files.role: Pydantic models for the normalized CalendarEventRow and CalendarConnectionStatusRow shapes that populate Dataset rows. These are the shared_views types.
FastAPI router. Defines all four exposed HTTP endpoints: connect_start, connect_callback, get_events, get_status.

methods.name: connect_start
methods.purpose: Generate CSRF nonce, persist it, return RedirectResponse to Google consent URL with scope=calendar.readonly.

methods.name: connect_callback
methods.purpose: Validate CSRF nonce, exchange auth code for tokens, upsert connection and token records, delete nonce, return 200 or api_error.

methods.name: get_events
methods.purpose: Check connection, refresh token if needed, fetch Google Calendar events, return Dataset with object_type=calendar_event.

methods.name: get_status
methods.purpose: Read calendar_connection record and return Dataset with object_type=calendar_connection. Returns status=not_connected row if no record exists. Never returns api_error.

files.role: Google OAuth 2.0 helpers: authorization URL construction, code-for-token exchange, token refresh. Uses httpx. Reads GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET from environment.

methods.name: build_authorization_url
methods.purpose: Return the Google OAuth authorization URL with scope=calendar.readonly, access_type=offline, and prompt=consent.

methods.name: exchange_code_for_tokens
methods.purpose: POST to Google token endpoint with auth code. Return token response dict containing access_token, refresh_token, expires_in, token_type, scope. Raise ValueError on error response.

methods.name: refresh_access_token
methods.purpose: POST to Google token endpoint with refresh_token. Return updated token dict with access_token and expires_in. Raise ValueError on 4xx (revoked/expired refresh token).

files.role: Google Calendar API v3 client. Fetches events from the primary calendar for a given time window using httpx. Returns a list of CalendarEventRow.

methods.name: fetch_events
methods.purpose: Call Google Calendar API v3 events.list for the primary calendar with timeMin=from_dt and timeMax=to_dt. Normalize each item into CalendarEventRow. Raise ValueError on non-2xx response.

files.role: Database access layer for calendar_connection, calendar_token, and calendar_oauth_state tables. All DB reads and writes for this component go through this module.

methods.name: get_connection
methods.purpose: Return the single calendar_connection row as a dict, or None if absent.

methods.name: upsert_connection
methods.purpose: Insert or update the calendar_connection row. Return the connection id.

methods.name: update_connection_status
methods.purpose: Update status and last_error on the calendar_connection row. Update updated_at.

methods.name: record_success
methods.purpose: Update last_success_at and updated_at on the calendar_connection row.

methods.name: get_token
methods.purpose: Return the calendar_token row as a dict (including access_token, refresh_token, token_expiry), or None if absent.

methods.name: upsert_token
methods.purpose: Insert or update the calendar_token row for the given connection_id.

methods.name: create_oauth_state
methods.purpose: Insert a new calendar_oauth_state row with the given nonce and expiry.

methods.name: consume_oauth_state
methods.purpose: Delete the calendar_oauth_state row with the matching nonce if it exists and has not expired. Return True if deleted (valid), False if not found or expired.

files.role: Initial schema migration. Creates calendar_connection, calendar_token, and calendar_oauth_state tables. Idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS). Wrapped in BEGIN/COMMIT.

Python project definition for calendar_connector. Declares dependencies: fastapi, uvicorn, psycopg2-binary, httpx, pydantic, platform_errorhandling (local), platform_contracts (local).
Test stubs for OAuth connect start and callback flows. Test scenarios defined in architecture.json deferrals.test_writer.
Test stubs for GET /api/calendar/events endpoint covering all connection and token failure modes and Dataset contract compliance.
Test stubs for GET /api/calendar/status endpoint covering absent connection and connected states, and verifying no token values in response.
